about.bio: Results-driven and highly adaptive Full Stack Software Developer & Cloud Engineer with over 3 years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and scaling high-growth production systems. Specialized in architecting clean .NET Core microservices, migrating legacy enterprise systems to secure, high-performance AWS serverless environments (Lambda, SQS, API Gateway, Cognito, Amplify), and optimizing relational databases. A seasoned algorithmic trading developer with extensive expertise in TradingView Pine Script, building custom indicators (like the HeikenAshi indicator and the Direwolf strategy system), and deploying real-time financial data visualizers (like The Dart dashboard) utilizing WebSockets and modern React frameworks.
